baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Condensate pump. A pump that collects and removes condensate from air conditioning, refrigeration and dehumidification equipment: a plastic tank and enclosure, a float switch, a safety switch, an impeller and a 1/30 horsepower motor. The Condensate pump is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from China.

The 1/30 horsepower motor, impeller, fan and volute, tank, tank cover, motor cover and plastic enclosure and float switch, micro-switches, floats, brackets and wiring harness are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: screw the motor mounting plate onto the motor and place the water slinger on the shaft; screw the motor subassembly onto the tank cover, press the fan and impeller onto the motor shaft, weld the volute, connect the wiring, fit the motor cover and feet, test.

key_factors: The 1/30 horsepower motor, impeller, volute, tank, and switches produced in China
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the core pump components (motor, impeller, volute, tank, switches) in China
prediction.reasoning: Unlike N347272 or N338945 where significant component fabrication (stamping, molding) and complex subassembly occurred in Thailand, all components of the condensate pump—including the motor, impeller, volute, tank, and switches—are manufactured in China. The Chinese components, particularly the motor and pumping elements, impart the essential character. The operations in Thailand (screwing, pressing, simple welding, connecting wires) constitute mere simple assembly that does not substantially transform the pre-made Chinese components.

In Variant A, the motor and all other components are made in China and merely assembled in Thailand, resulting in Chinese origin. In Variant B, manufacturing the motor stator and rotor from laminations and windings, assembling the motor, and performing final pump assembly in Thailand substantially transforms the Chinese components, shifting origin to Thailand.
